```{r setup}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(sf)
library(BSol.mapR)
```


## Current Pharmacy Provision

```{r load-pharm-data}

pharm_data <- read.csv("../data/birmingham_geocoded.csv") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  rename(
    postcode = birmingham_post_code,
    name = birmingham_organisation_name) %>%
  select(
    postcode, name, contains("opening_hours")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    popup_text = paste0(
      "<b>", name, "</b><br><br>",
      "<b>Monday</b>:", birmingham_pharmacy_opening_hours_monday, "<br>",
      "<b>Tuesday</b>:", birmingham_pharmacy_opening_hours_tuesday, "<br>",
      "<b>Wednesday</b>:", birmingham_pharmacy_opening_hours_wednesday, "<br>",
      "<b>Thursday</b>:", birmingham_pharmacy_opening_hours_thursday, "<br>",
      "<b>Friday</b>:", birmingham_pharmacy_opening_hours_friday, "<br>",
      "<b>Saturday</b>:", birmingham_pharmacy_opening_hours_saturday, "<br>",
      "<b>Sunday</b>:", birmingham_pharmacy_opening_hours_sunday
    )
  )

postcodes <- read.csv("../data/West Midlands postcodes.csv") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(
    postcode, longitude, latitude
  )

```

There are currently `r nrow(pharm_data)` pharmacies in Birmingham.

```{r map-pharm-locs}
pharm_data_pcs <- pharm_data %>%
  left_join(
    postcodes,
    by = join_by("postcode")
  ) %>%
  rename(lng = longitude, lat = latitude)

#pharm_loc_shp <- st_as_sf(get_points_shape(pharm_data_pcs))

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  setView(lng = -1.876932, lat = 52.4777, zoom = 11) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = pharm_data_pcs, radius = 5,
                   stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.5, popup = ~popup_text)
```
